code.title: Put it in your product
code.line: Paste the key into your product, then send a question like this one. The answer comes back as text.

tabs.label: JavaScript
Python
tabs.code:
import os, requests

res = requests.post(
    "https://api.willpowerlab.com/v2/models/job/answer",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['WILLPOWERLAB_KEY']}"},
    json={"message": "How do I answer: what is your biggest weakness?"},
)
answer, sure = res.json()["answer"], res.json()["sure"]

tabs.label: curl
tabs.code:
curl https://api.willpowerlab.com/v2/models/job/answer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WILLPOWERLAB_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"message": "How do I answer: what is your biggest weakness?"}'

code.sure: Each answer comes with “sure”: true or false. When it is false, show the answer as a draft, or pass the question to a person.

earnings.line: Pitch Coach version 1 earned you 41,000 tokens this month.
earnings.fixed: Your share is fixed for version 1. It grows with each answer that counts; hard clips count for more. Answers you give now count toward version 2.
earnings.minimum: We pay once a month when you have earned €20 or more. Before your first payout, we ask for your name and bank details, as every payment service must.

download.title: Download its data
lines: You can download what Pitch Coach has learned from, and build your own on it.
You get your teachers’ ratings and answers. What speakers said is left out until the training yes says it may be shared. Recordings stay with WillpowerLab.
You may build on it, test it and research with it for free. To sell a product built on it, you need a licence, and its teachers share what that earns.
